## Review checklist

<!-- Check only items that have been verified. Explain any item that does not apply. -->

- [ ] The change addresses a concrete problem and excludes unrelated work.
- [ ] Relevant tests cover the changed behavior, and CI includes them or manual-validation limits are explained.
- [ ] Documentation and commands match the implementation.
- [ ] Public/hidden data boundaries are preserved, and no secrets or licensed simulator data are included.
- [ ] The description and validation evidence reflect the current revision.
